baseline_controls.stage_probe:
measure input:r mode:t > i
let body read input
if (text_eq mode "bytes") (text_len body)
if (text_eq mode "scan") (length (json_words body))
if (text_eq mode "parse") (length (get lists (read_scalar_json body internal_json false)))
let data read_scalar_json body internal_json false
let schemas validated_schema (schema_blocks "variant Outcome\nwaiting finish\n\nrecord Cursor\nlabel:t pos:i" false) "types.tide"
let kind "*&{Cursor}{Outcome}"
let token need (json_at data ".entries") "entries" 0
let value need (get value (read_argument data ".entries" token kind schemas)) "input" 0
sequence_size value
baseline_controls.notes: Initial controls use projection.tide with import of composite_pairs.tide. Keys in initial_cli_and_direct_checker end in true for direct checker, false for CLI. Stages are cumulative end-to-end measurements in separate processes. Nine runs after three warmups for these exploratory controls.

validation.make_check_no_python: passed; includes full clean build, bootstrap fixed point, package upgrade, installed CLI and write failure
validation.sanitizers: One targeted projected snapshot program generated from compiler_checks.tide passed UBSan with production limits. For the isolated ASan+UBSan build only, the address-space cap was lifted to allow ASan shadow allocation. The stock 512 MiB cap prevents full-program ASan startup.
validation.compiler_flags: -std=c++20 -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer for the ASan fixture; -fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined for the capped UBSan fixture

reproduce.position_args: tide run composite_pairs.tide --call positions --inputs <compact JSON>; copied unchanged into a temporary directory with tide.lock. For row count use projection.tide in the same directory.
reproduce.count_source:
use composite_pairs

count_rows entries:*&{Cursor}{Outcome} > i
length entries
reproduce.input_rule: entries[i] = [{label:"Ω"+i,pos:i-40},i%2?"finish":"waiting"]; for late-invalid cases replace final status with unknown.
reproduce.audit: compare baseline and final stdout and stderr bytes including newline plus exit code, verify independently expected valid results, validate rejected codes. CLI comparison includes revision-bound edit dry-run and write, lock mismatch and file I/O errors.
